App.name: HupSup POS
App.tagline: All-in-one POS for small shops. Works offline. Supports LAK + THB.

Landing.heroTitle: A POS for small shops that works even without internet
Landing.heroSubtitle: Sales, inventory, members, promotions, and reports — everything in one system. Built for shops in Laos and Thailand.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: Keep selling when the internet drops. The app syncs automatically when it comes back.

multiCurrency.title: LAK + THB in one bill
multiCurrency.desc: Accept both currencies in a single transaction with daily exchange rates.

verticals.title: Multiple shop types
verticals.desc: Retail, restaurant, and service businesses — one system for all.

selfHost.title: Self-host on your VPS
selfHost.desc: No vendor lock-in. Own your data 100%.
